acceptanceCriteria: delivery-screen reports a HELD verdict with holdId and reason, and a COMPLETED verdict, ahead of PR evidence.
The latest ticket note is included per ticket.
Focused tests cover each verdict; the spec is updated with numbered requirements; the read stays lock-free and write-free.
body: Observed 2026-10-22: the pre-dispatch screen needs three reads (delivery-screen, holds, notes) to drop tickets already delivered, held for an owner decision, or already dispatched to a lane. Extend `ticket delivery-screen` so one call gives the dispatch verdict: add HELD (hold id and reason) and COMPLETED verdicts from the store, surface the latest operator note, and accept `--prs -` for a piped `gh pr list` export.
title: Tasks: delivery-screen also reports HELD, COMPLETED and noted in-flight tickets, and reads the PR export from stdin
